query:
insert into DetectedReqTraces (
                        latest_collection,
                        req_id,
                        file_hash,
                        line
                    )
                    values (
                        $1,
                        $2,
                        $3,
                        $4
                    )
                    on conflict (req_id, file_hash, line)
                    do update set
                        latest_collection = excluded.latest_collection
